# A spliced body's handles are each copy's own, as its vars are, and a read
# through one reaches its own copy: a var of a component instance (`k.count`
# off `counter #k`, state.sngl), the cell behind a two-way prop the call site
# left unbound (`box.value`, cell.sngl), and what an override reads of its own
# node (inputs.sngl).
#
# The inliner gave every copy the checker's one handle, so a read in a copy
# could not say which copy it meant. gtk4's input asks its own entry for its
# text, and any component rendering an input twice was refused; an unbound
# cell read in a component rendered twice was refused; and `k.count` was never
# answered at all -- the interpreter read nil, and fyne, bubbletea and gtk4
# emitted a field nothing declared. Each splice now records the copy of each
# var it made under the handle its node carries (resolveHandleVarReads), and
# a test reaches the copy's through the splice's handles.

sngl test --platform=none state.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html state.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go state.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go state.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go state.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c state.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go state.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c state.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin state.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none cell.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html cell.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go cell.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go cell.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c cell.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go cell.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c cell.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin cell.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none inputs.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html inputs.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go inputs.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go inputs.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go inputs.sngl

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c inputs.sngl

stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c inputs.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin inputs.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

-- state.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component counter ui.node {
    var count = 0
    effect(on=count, @mount(v) {})
    ui.button #inc(text="+", @click { count += 1 })
}

component field ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        counter #k()
        ui.text #out(value="[{k.count}]")
    }
}

component pair ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        field #one()
        field #two()
    }
}

ui.window {
    pair()
}

func testOwn(t test.Test, c pair) {
    c.one.k.inc.click()
    t.assert(c.one.out.value == "[1]")
    t.assert(c.two.out.value == "[0]")
}
-- cell.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component field ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.input #box()
        ui.text #out(value="[{box.value}]")
    }
}

component pair ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        field #one()
        field #two()
    }
}

ui.window {
    pair()
}

func testEachCopyReadsItsOwnCell(t test.Test, c pair) {
    t.assert(c.one.out.value == "[]")
    c.one.box.input("hi")
    t.assert(c.one.out.value == "[hi]")
    t.assert(c.two.out.value == "[]")
}
-- inputs.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component field ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.input #name()
    }
}

component pair ui.node {
    ui.vbox {
        field #one()
        field #two()
    }
}

ui.window {
    pair()
}

func testEachInputIsItsOwn(t test.Test, c pair) {
    c.one.name.input("a")
    t.assert(c.one.name.value == "a")
    t.assert(c.two.name.value == "")
}

// The component under test is the test's own instance, and nothing splices
// it: its input's cell is reached through the handles it was written with.
func testOneInputIsTheTests(t test.Test, c field) {
    c.name.input("a")
    t.assert(c.name.value == "a")
}
